requirements.requirement: All game rules, physics, collision, combat, AI and bot behaviour live only in the Rust simulation/policy/ headless stack (`rh-sim`, `rh-policy`, `rh-headless`). Unity render animation and projectile presentation never decide hits or other game outcomes.

requirements.requirement: Pursue the **highest sustainable frame rate** while preserving intended gameplay, readability and visual quality. The owner selected **Apple M5 Pro** as the initial named reference on 2026-11-05 and explicitly replaced the earlier 60 FPS goal with a request to measure how far performance can be pushed. Report CPU/GPU frame-time distributions and browser/display limits separately; do not infer rendered FPS from the Rust server's throughput. Frame time, memory, download size and load time have explicit measured budgets. Verify representative crowded gameplay, not just a movement smoke; results do not establish performance on other hardware.
